turns.query: Retrospectively estimate the Aalen–Johansen competing-risk model for California SBA 7(a) approval-fiscal-year 2020–2022 public loan rows with a recorded first disbursement on or before 2024-12-31. Treat each reported row as one equally weighted subject. Loan age is actual days since first disbursement; the first dated charge-off or paid-in-full event is absorbing, with charge-off winning a same-row date tie. Administratively censor at 2024-12-31 and retain event-day subjects in the pre-event risk set, including same-day censors. Report cohort count, active and charge-off probabilities at day 730 and the ordinary case-weight infinitesimal-jackknife standard error of that charge-off probability. Carry the full estimated transition law forward and interpret the estimated credit risk, its uncertainty and its financial scope. Use unrounded states throughout.

Condition the carried transition law on being active at loan age 730 days. For ages strictly after 730 through and including 1460, report conditional charge-off and paid-in-full probabilities and restricted mean remaining active time in that interval. Carry this conditional law forward and interpret the seasoning assessment.

Price a hypothetical credit-protection contract using the carried conditional event law as its actuarial probability law. Protection begins at age 730 and expires at 1460; it pays 60 percent of notional immediately at charge-off and nothing at paid-in-full. Premium accrues and is paid continuously while active, with Actual/365 year fractions and no separate event-date accrued-premium payment. Use a flat annual-effective discount rate equal to New York Fed SOFR on 2024-12-31, measured from inception at age 730. Report the fair annual premium spread and Macaulay duration of discounted default-benefit payments. Carry the contract and discount convention forward and discuss the pricing interpretation.

For the carried protection contract, apply a stress that multiplies each estimated charge-off hazard increment after day 730 by 1.5 while leaving the paid-in-full hazard increments unchanged. Keep inception active at day 730 and all contract, discount and horizon conventions fixed. Report the stressed conditional charge-off probability, fair annual premium spread and discounted default-payment Macaulay duration. Interpret the resulting premium and payment-timing changes.
